title: Codex
current: All SessionStart sources run the hook, but the client skips any start without a transcript path before relay and registration. Saved forks retain their own session identity and start cache. Every registration path needs a saved transcript: the server never creates or revives a session row from a Codex hook without a transcript path, including lazy registration from tool-call hooks, so unsaved Desktop helper threads stay unregistered while their tool calls are still evaluated. Transcript and usage credentials honor CODEX_HOME. Project refresh renews changed hook trust.
